material_findings.title: Telegraph Hackathon Season II — $7,000 main awards plus $3,000 reserved for separate December challenges
material_findings.facts: Official H2 competition opens Nov 1 and closes Dec 1 2026 23:59 UTC. Organizer advertises $10,000 USD, but only $7,000 belongs to this main competition; $3,000 is reserved for later separately ruled December challenges. Apps & Agents track is $3,000 ($1,800 delivery and $1,200 excellence), with eight $225 delivery awards and $700/$350/$150 excellence awards. Solo or team allowed. Free registration stated on official tracks page. Reused own/open-source code permitted with disclosure, but H2 transaction evidence must be from event period. App needs a genuine autonomous Telegraph purchase/sale; supported testnet qualifies. Nov 14 is non-disqualifying progress milestone. 2-5 minute demo and reproducible receipts required. Current rules score Apps at 35/30/15/10/10; separate /judging page still displays a different older 35/30/20/10/5 scheme and 60-second demo; treat /rules as current binding rules until organizer resolves inconsistency.
material_findings.entry_cost: Free to register; any Telegraph testnet/mainnet transaction, hosting or infrastructure costs not verified.
material_findings.eligibility: Country exclusions, age, identity, tax, supported payout method and timing not independently verified; organizer refers to separate prize-payment terms not located in accessible rules.
material_findings.authorization: Development competition only; no public-system testing authorization.
material_findings.next_action: Locate binding prize-payment terms and reconcile /judging page with /rules; verify registration, country eligibility, free testnet access, spending limits, supported SDK and judge-accessible submission before activating.

material_findings.title: BCH BLAZE 2026 — $8,000 token-denominated prize headline and sponsor bounties
material_findings.facts: Organizer reports online BCH hackathon Nov 14-22, 2026, registration closes Nov 13, solo or teams up to four, showcase Nov 28. Advertised $8,000 prizes are payable in ParyonUSD CashToken, not verified fiat cash. Separate bounty board lists 8 BCH plus $1,250 PUSD across four sponsor bounties; do not add to $8,000 headline without confirming overlap. Bounty terms explicitly state submitting waives IP-related rights, and XO template/migration bounties reject AI-written feedback. Sponsor payout is discretionary after judging; exact token redemption/liquidity and legal effect require review.
material_findings.entry_cost: Not verified from binding rules; blockchain transaction/hosting costs may apply.
material_findings.eligibility: Geographic and age eligibility, wallet requirements, token redemption and tax terms not verified.
material_findings.authorization: Only competition-provided build tasks; bounty listing is not authorization for external security testing.
material_findings.next_action: Review official DoraHacks rules and legal IP waiver; confirm entry costs, participant eligibility, prize denominated token redemption, overlap with sponsor bounties and project ownership before active case creation.
